title: Pinecrest Fresh Cut: a leafy greens hold, trace and recall
summary: A Salinas, California fresh-cut leafy greens processor with one plant, three distribution centers, a retail chain, a foodservice distributor and a co-packer, and an exercise generated from its simulated plans: a presumptive E. coli O157:H7 result on a retained romaine sample, a lot trace across the network against the 24-hour records request, a recall decision and letters whose counts must reconcile.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Pinecrest Fresh Cut, its growers, customers, carriers, co-packer, insurer and people are simulated, and no real outbreak or product is depicted; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/pinecrest-recall/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Presumptive
scenarios.summary: A lab reports a presumptive E. coli O157:H7 positive on a retained sample of romaine from one packing line; the team has hours to hold five lots, trace 38,600 cases across three distribution centers, a co-packer with paper records and a distributor, decide on a Class I recall and send letters and a press release whose counts agree.
